# Web Site

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/WebSite>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A web site — the published collection of web pages served under one identity (a domain, a project site, a personal homepage). A specialization of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md); its pages belong to it via [`gmeow:pageOfSite`](../properties/gmeow-pageOfSite.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the published collection of web pages served under one identity — a domain, project site, or personal homepage that pages belong to.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a single page within the site (use [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md)) and avoid storing breadcrumb navigation as a vocabulary — the page→site hierarchy is walked by the projection.

### How to use

- Type the site [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md), give it a [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md), and attach each page via [`gmeow:pageOfSite`](../properties/gmeow-pageOfSite.md) (a [`gmeow:partOf`](../properties/gmeow-partOf.md) specialization); it projects to [schema:WebSite.](https://schema.org/WebSite.)

### Examples

- ex:site a [`gmeow:WebSite`](gmeow-WebSite.md); [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:siteTitle.
